meta.title: The SafeHer Network
meta.description: SafeHer is SafeSiso's network of verified safe spaces across Northern Ghana — local organizations and clinics that a girl can be connected to when she needs more than information.

hero.title: Verified safe spaces, and a door that is actually open
hero.intro: Information alone is not enough for a girl who is being hurt. SafeHer is the network of local organizations and clinics that SafeSiso can connect her to — and it is built so that she is never sent somewhere that cannot receive her.

whatIsIt.heading: What a safe space is
whatIsIt.intro: A SafeHer partner is a local organization, clinic or NGO that has agreed to receive and support an adolescent girl who arrives needing help.

points.title: Local, not distant
points.body: Partners operate in the communities SafeSiso serves, so a referral is somewhere a girl can realistically reach.

points.title: Prepared for this
points.body: Partners are organizations that already work with adolescent girls on sexual and reproductive health, abuse or protection — not general services asked to improvise.

points.title: Non-judgmental by agreement
points.body: Being listed means committing to receive a girl without shaming, lecturing or reporting her to her community.

points.title: Honest about capacity
points.body: Partners keep their availability current, so the network reflects who can actually help right now.

verification.heading: How partners are verified
verification.intro: Nothing gets onto the SafeHer List by filling in a form. Verification exists because a bad referral is worse than no referral.

steps.title: The organization applies
steps.body: An organization gets in touch and describes the services it provides, the communities it covers, and its experience working with adolescent girls.

steps.title: Credentials are checked
steps.body: Registration, safeguarding practice and adolescent-services experience are reviewed with PPAG before anything is listed.

steps.title: Onboarding and training
steps.body: Verified partners are onboarded onto the referral process and the partner portal, so that a referral arriving at 11pm is understood and acted on.

steps.title: Availability stays live
steps.body: Once active, a partner maintains its own current capacity in the portal. That is what keeps the matching engine honest.

howReferralWorks.heading: How a referral reaches a partner
howReferralWorks.body: When SafeSiso detects that a girl may need more than information, it tells her and offers a connection. If she accepts, the matching engine looks for a verified partner in her area that has confirmed availability, and notifies them that someone needs support.
howReferralWorks.privacy: The partner is told that support is needed. They are not sent her conversation, and they are not sent her identity — because SafeSiso never collected one.
howReferralWorks.cta: See how the detection works, step by step

directory.heading: Where the network operates
directory.intro: The pilot covers three regions. Partner onboarding begins ahead of launch, and this section will list the number of verified, active partners in each region once they are onboarded.
directory.emptyBody: No partners are listed yet. Rather than show placeholder organizations, this stays empty until real partners are verified and active.
directory.targetNote: The pilot has committed to a minimum of ten verified safe space partners across the three northern regions.
directory.locationHeading: Why we show regions, not addresses
directory.locationBody: Partner locations are shown by region only. Publishing the exact address of a safe space could expose both the organization and the girls seen walking into it. A girl who is offered a referral is given what she needs to get there, privately, in her own conversation — it does not need to be on a public web page.

forPartners.heading: For organizations
forPartners.joinBody: If your organization works with adolescent girls in the Northern, Upper East or Upper West regions, we would like to hear from you.
forPartners.loginBody: Verified partners sign in to manage their availability and see referrals sent to them.
